# SovStack

> Open-source digital sovereignty stack builder. Replace surveillance platforms and build your independent privacy stack.

## Overview
SovStack is an open-source privacy tool suite that allows users to replace surveillance tech monoliths (Google, Meta, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, ByteDance, OpenAI) with verified Free and Open Source (FOSS), End-to-End Encrypted (E2EE), and self-hostable alternatives across 24 software categories.

- **Website**: https://abdullahon2006.github.io/sovstack
- **License**: MIT License (Open Source)
- **Privacy**: Zero cookies, zero remote tracking, zero telemetry.
- **Full LLM Documentation**: https://abdullahon2006.github.io/sovstack/llms-full.txt

## Key Software Categories & Top Alternatives
1. **Email**: Replace Gmail/Outlook with Proton Mail, Tuta Mail, mailbox.org, Posteo.
2. **Search**: Replace Google Search/Bing with DuckDuckGo, Brave Search, Kagi, SearXNG, Startpage.
3. **Web Browser**: Replace Google Chrome/Edge with Firefox, LibreWolf, Mullvad Browser, Brave, Tor Browser.
4. **Mobile OS**: Replace Google Android/iOS with GrapheneOS, CalyxOS, LineageOS.
5. **Desktop OS**: Replace Windows/macOS with Debian, Fedora, Arch Linux, Linux Mint, Qubes OS.
6. **Cloud Storage**: Replace Google Drive/OneDrive/Dropbox with Proton Drive, Nextcloud, Filen.
7. **Photo Backup**: Replace Google Photos/iCloud Photos with Ente Photos, Immich, Nextcloud Memories.
8. **Navigation & Maps**: Replace Google Maps/Waze/Apple Maps with Organic Maps, OsmAnd.
9. **Password Manager**: Replace Google Passwords/Apple Keychain/LastPass with Bitwarden, Vaultwarden, KeePassXC.
10. **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**: Replace Google Authenticator with Aegis Authenticator, 2FAS, Ente Auth.
11. **Notes & Knowledge Base**: Replace Google Keep/OneNote/Apple Notes with Obsidian, Joplin, Standard Notes.
12. **Instant Messaging**: Replace WhatsApp/Messenger/iMessage with Signal, SimpleX Chat, Session, Matrix/Element.
13. **Social Media**: Replace Instagram/Facebook/Twitter/Reddit with Mastodon, Pixelfed, Lemmy, Bluesky.
14. **Video Streaming**: Replace YouTube with NewPipe, FreeTube, PeerTube, Jellyfin.
15. **Office Documents**: Replace Google Docs/Microsoft 365 with LibreOffice, CryptPad, OnlyOffice.
16. **Keyboards**: Replace Gboard/SwiftKey with FUTO Keyboard, HeliBoard, FlorisBoard.
17. **DNS & Ad Blocking**: Replace Google DNS/ISP DNS with Quad9, NextDNS, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home.
18. **AI Assistants**: Replace Google Gemini/ChatGPT/Meta AI with local Ollama, Venice AI, DuckDuckGo AI.
19. **App Stores**: Replace Google Play Store/Apple App Store with F-Droid, Aurora Store, Obtainium.
20. **Web Analytics**: Replace Google Analytics/Meta Pixel with Plausible Analytics, Umami.
21. **Smart Home**: Replace Google Home/Amazon Alexa with Home Assistant.
22. **Remote Desktop**: Replace TeamViewer/AnyDesk with RustDesk.
23. **Digital Payments**: Replace Google Pay/Apple Pay with Cash, Monero (XMR).
24. **Virtual Private Networks (VPN)**: Replace commercial logging VPNs with Mullvad VPN, Proton VPN, IVPN, self-hosted WireGuard.

## Corporate Surveillance Dossiers
Detailed dossier profiles on data-harvesting practices:
- **Alphabet (Google)**: Ad profiling, continuous geolocation tracking, AI training ingestion, cross-service graphing.
- **Meta (Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp)**: Shadow profiles, behavioral ad auctions, third-party pixel ingestion.
- **Microsoft**: Operating system telemetry, Office diagnostics logging, Copilot telemetry.
- **Apple**: Closed ecosystem lock-in, iCloud server-side key escrow (by default), App Store search ad telemetry.
- **Amazon**: Alexa ambient audio ingestion, Ring surveillance networks, purchase profiling.
- **ByteDance**: TikTok biometric keystroke telemetry, in-app browser script injection.
- **OpenAI**: Prompt retention, behavioral training ingestion, closed model weights.

## Digital Sovereignty Scoring
Sovereignty percentage is calculated on a 0-100% scale based on evicted surveillance monopolies and verified architectural trust badges:
- Base Category Switch: +10 pts
- Zero-Knowledge Architecture: +3 pts
- End-to-End Encryption (E2EE): +2 pts
- Free and Open Source (FOSS): +2 pts
- Self-Hostable Capability: +2 pts
